result.title: Indistinguishable Agents: Training Agent Privacy as Twin-World Indistinguishability
result.summary: LLM agents search, shop and send messages for their users, and every action is seen by some party. Existing privacy training rewards agents for not mentioning protected items, yet an observer can infer a private fact from what the agent does. Since an observer learns a fact only if its view changes with the fact, we propose \methodfull (\method), which trains on twin worlds that differ only in the private fact. A frozen distinguisher scores each observer's view by its log-likelihood ratio for the true world, and paired GRPO trains the agent on task success minus this ratio. We prove that this objective controls the Bayes success of every observer on every channel. On shopping and messaging tasks \method removes the leakage that disclosure judges and query-level rewards miss, while the agent still completes its tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出「双世界不可区分」训练：构造仅在私有事实上有差异的世界对，用冻结判别器按对数似然比评估观察者视图，并以任务成功减该比值做成对 GRPO，证明该目标可约束任意观察者、任意信道上的贝叶斯推断成功率，在购物与消息任务中消除披露判断与查询级奖励漏掉的泄漏。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「观察者视图是否随事实而变」的可区分性度量与似然比监督，可能为 LVR 中核查视觉证据是否真正进入 latent 状态、信息坍缩与贡献分配提供探测式工具，属可迁移的方法线索，需人工核查。
